verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Unleash ships backend SDKs, backend tokens, and an `isEnabled` call. It also documents Unleash Edge as a caching layer and read replica. None of this states that server SDKs evaluate flags in-process from a locally cached ruleset with no network call per check. Edge is a separate proxy service, not in-SDK local evaluation, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check
